text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond secured victory with a run 
that was truly her own.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Not only was her running flawless, she was 
even more powerful than before. Her 
training had clearly paid off.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now, next up is the long-awaited Tenno Sho 
(Autumn)! I'll take on both Mejiro McQueen 
and Kitasan Black!
